svg.aria-label: Independently constructed teaching spectrum; two arbitrary peak positions illustrate overlap without assigning elements. A varies energy resolution; B jointly fits two peaks and background; C checks count-scaled residuals; D shows precision for background-free Poisson counts. Complete code generates the values.
